title: Immaculate Constellation answers to the National Security Council

tellings.quote: When it comes to immaculate constellation, it appears that the Cognizant authority uh the ultimate like uh where the buck stops is in the is in the National Security Council

plain: A Pentagon whistleblower named Matthew Brown says that a secret programme called Immaculate Constellation, which by his account handles data on UAP (unidentified anomalous phenomena, the government's current term for UFOs), answers in the end to the National Security Council at the White House. He tells Michels that the programme's "cognizant authority", meaning the office where "the buck stops", "appears" to sit there. If so, oversight of UFO secrets would reach the president's own national security staff.
